caseNameFull: McCarthy, Director, California Department of Corrections v. Blair

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 807;] Judgment vacated and case remanded to the Court of Appeals with directions that it instruct the United States District Court for the Central District of California to vacate its order and dismiss the petition for writ of habeas corpus as moot. United States v. Munsingwear, Inc., 340 U. S. 36 (1950).
